# KooLearn

> KooLearn is a leading online education platform specializing in in-service graduate programs and professional degree exam preparation in China.

KooLearn (新东方) provides comprehensive training and guidance for working professionals seeking to advance their education through postgraduate programs, with partnerships across top Chinese universities including Renmin University, Shandong University, and East China University of Political Science and Law.

## Key Topics

- 在职研究生 (In-Service Graduate Programs)
- MBA/MPA/MEM (Professional Master's Degrees)
- 同等学力申硕 (Equivalent Academic Degree Master's)
- 考试辅导 (Exam Preparation)
- 硕士学位 (Master's Degree)
- 免试入学 (Tuition-Free Admission)
- 院校招生 (University Enrollment)
- 学历提升 (Education Advancement)
- 专业发展 (Professional Development)
- 中国人民大学 (Renmin University of China)
- 新东方 (New Oriental Education)
- 复旦大学 (Fudan University)
- 北京师范大学 (Beijing Normal University)
- enrollment-guidance
- zero-foundation-courses

## In-Service Graduate Programs

- [新东方在职考研](https://www.koolearn.com/ke/zaizhi): 在职研究生课程：MBA、MPA、MEM等专业学位考试培训
- [同等学力课程-新东方在线英语官网](https://www.koolearn.com/ke/sameedu): 同等学力申硕课程：在职研究生学历提升项目及相关培训
